  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":9,"var":"data","code":"if (size < BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH) return 0;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are accepted as a candidate compressed chunk only when they are long enough to contain a Blosc header."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":19,"var":"nbytes/cbytes/blocksize","code":"blosc_cbuffer_sizes(data, &nbytes, &cbytes, &blocksize);","note":"The fuzzer parses the header fields directly from the attacker input, propagating the claimed uncompressed size and compressed size into local variables."},
  {"step":3,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"cbytes","code":"if (cbytes != size || nbytes == 0) { ... return 0; }","note":"The input is only decompressed when the header-reported compressed size exactly matches the file size and the chunk claims a nonzero output size."},
  {"step":4,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":26,"var":"nbytes","code":"if (blosc_cbuffer_validate(data, size, &nbytes) != 0) return 0;","note":"Validation reuses the attacker-controlled header and rejects malformed size fields, leaving only structurally plausible chunks to reach the sink."},
  {"step":5,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":30,"var":"output","code":"output = malloc(cbytes);","note":"The destination buffer is sized from the attacker-controlled compressed length, so the decompressor writes into a heap buffer chosen by the input."},
  {"step":6,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":34,"var":"blosc2_decompress(data, size, output, cbytes)","code":"blosc2_decompress(data, size, output, cbytes);","note":"The validated chunk is handed to the library decompressor, which is the memory-safety sink exercised by the fuzz target and the likely site of the uninitialized-value bug."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
